record.question: The PMJDY primarily focuses on which of the following?
record.explanation: Answer B: Financial inclusion. Pradhan Mantri Jan-Dhan Yojana aims at financial inclusion, including access to accounts and related services. Reference: https://pmjdy.gov.in/about. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: General Studies Paper-II, January 2026 examination; current affairs are interpreted as of the paper date.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
